Agent.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					s.status === "",
					s.version === 0,
					s.current_version_id === "",
					s.name === "",
					s.model_id === "",
					!s.has_system,
					s.system === "",
					!s.has_description,
					s.description === "",
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					s.status !== "",
					s.version >= 1,
					s.current_version_id !== "",
					s.name !== "",
					s.model_id !== "",
					[s.has_system, s.system === ""].some((ok) => ok),
					[s.has_description, s.description === ""].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.ArchivedAgentStaysArchived.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "archived",
				[
					after.status === "archived",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.current_version_id === before.current_version_id,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.model_id === before.model_id,
					after.has_system === before.has_system,
					after.system === before.system,
					after.has_description === before.has_description,
					after.description === before.description,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Agent.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status === "",
				[
					after.status !== "",
					[
						after.version === before.version,
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

AgentVersion.MintedExactlyWhenNumbered.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[
					!s.minted,
					s.agent_id === "",
					s.version === 0,
					s.name === "",
					s.model_id === "",
					!s.has_system,
					s.system === "",
					!s.has_description,
					s.description === "",
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					s.minted,
					s.agent_id !== "",
					s.version >= 1,
					s.name !== "",
					s.model_id !== "",
					[s.has_system, s.system === ""].some((ok) => ok),
					[s.has_description, s.description === ""].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

AgentVersion.MintedVersionNeverChanges.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				!before.minted,
				[
					after.minted,
					after.agent_id === before.agent_id,
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
					after.model_id === before.model_id,
					after.has_system === before.has_system,
					after.system === before.system,
					after.has_description === before.has_description,
					after.description === before.description,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.CreatedExactlyWhenVersioned.source:
(s) =>
			[
				[s.status === "", s.version === 0, s.name === ""].every((ok) => ok),
				[s.status !== "", s.version >= 1, s.name !== ""].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.ArchivedNeverReactivates.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "archived",
				[
					after.status === "archived",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.DeletedStaysDeleted.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				before.status !== "deleted",
				[
					after.status === "deleted",
					after.version === before.version,
					after.name === before.name,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Environment.VersionGrowsByOneOrNotAtAll.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				[
					before.status === "",
					[
						[after.status === "", after.version === 0].every((ok) => ok),
						[after.status === "active", after.version === 1].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
				[
					before.status !== "",
					after.status !== "",
					[
						[after.version === before.version, after.name === before.name].every((ok) => ok),
						[
							before.status === "active",
							after.status === "active",
							after.version === before.version + 1,
						].every((ok) => ok),
					].some((ok) => ok),
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)

Session.TurnNeverDecreases.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn >= before.turn

Session.TurnAdvancesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.turn <= before.turn + 1

Session.ModelRequestsStartedNeverDecreas.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started >= before.model_requests_started

Session.ModelRequestsStartedGrowsByAtMos.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.model_requests_started <= before.model_requests_started + 1

Session.PendingUserMessagesGrowsByAtMost.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.pending_user_messages <= before.pending_user_messages + 1

Session.OnlySendUserMessageAddsPendingMe.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.pending_user_messages <= before.pending_user_messages ||
			command._tag === "SendUserMessage"

Session.OnlyArchiveSessionSetsArchivedFl.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			after._tag !== "Terminated" ||
			!after.archived ||
			(before._tag === "Terminated" && before.archived) ||
			command._tag === "ArchiveSession"

CreateAgent.NewAgentStartsAtVersionOne.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
			[
				before.agent.status === "",
				!before.version.minted,
				after.agent.status === "active",
				after.agent.version === 1,
				after.agent.current_version_id === command.version_id,
				after.version.minted,
				after.version.version === 1,
				after.version.agent_id === command.agent_id,
			].every((ok) => ok)

UpdateAgent.ChangeMintsNextVersionOrNoOp.source:
({ before, after, command }) => {
			const hasSystem = command.system !== null
			const system = command.system ?? ""
			const hasDescription = command.description !== null
			const description = command.description ?? ""
			const unchanged = [
				command.name === before.agent.name,
				command.model.id === before.agent.model_id,
				hasSystem === before.agent.has_system,
				system === before.agent.system,
				hasDescription === before.agent.has_description,
				description === before.agent.description,
			].every((same) => same)
			return [
				before.agent.status === "active",
				after.agent.status === "active",
				[
					[
						unchanged,
						after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
						after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
						after.version.minted === before.version.minted,
					].every((ok) => ok),
					[
						!unchanged,
						after.agent.version === before.agent.version + 1,
						after.agent.current_version_id === command.next_version_id,
						after.agent.name === command.name,
						after.agent.model_id === command.model.id,
						after.agent.has_system === hasSystem,
						after.agent.system === system,
						after.agent.has_description === hasDescription,
						after.agent.description === description,
						!before.version.minted,
						after.version.minted,
						after.version.version === after.agent.version,
						after.version.agent_id === command.agent_id,
					].every((ok) => ok),
				].some((ok) => ok),
			].every((ok) => ok)
		}

UpdateAgent.UnchangedConfigMintsNothing.source:
({ before, after, command }) => {
			const hasSystem = command.system !== null
			const system = command.system ?? ""
			const hasDescription = command.description !== null
			const description = command.description ?? ""
			return [
				before.agent.status !== "active",
				command.name !== before.agent.name,
				command.model.id !== before.agent.model_id,
				hasSystem !== before.agent.has_system,
				system !== before.agent.system,
				hasDescription !== before.agent.has_description,
				description !== before.agent.description,
				[
					after.agent.status === "active",
					after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
					after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
					after.version.minted === before.version.minted,
				].every((ok) => ok),
			].some((ok) => ok)
		}

AdmitSession.OnlyActiveAgentAndEnvironme.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before.agent.status === "active" &&
			before.environment.status === "active" &&
			before.session._tag === "Uninitialized" &&
			after.session._tag === "Idle" &&
			after.session.turn === 0

AdmitSession.AdmissionLeavesAgentAndEnvi.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			[
				after.agent.status === before.agent.status,
				after.agent.version === before.agent.version,
				after.agent.current_version_id === before.agent.current_version_id,
				after.agent.name === before.agent.name,
				after.agent.model_id === before.agent.model_id,
				after.agent.has_system === before.agent.has_system,
				after.agent.system === before.agent.system,
				after.agent.has_description === before.agent.has_description,
				after.agent.description === before.agent.description,
				after.environment.status === before.environment.status,
				after.environment.version === before.environment.version,
				after.environment.name === before.environment.name,
			].every((ok) => ok)

Checkfu.AMintedVersionBelongsToItsAgent.source:
({ version, agent }) =>
				[
					!version.state.minted,
					version.state.agent_id !== agent.id,
					[agent.state.status !== "", version.state.version <= agent.state.version].every(
						(ok) => ok,
					),
				].some((ok) => ok)

Checkfu.AnAgentsHeadIsItsLatestVersion.source:
({ agent, version }) =>
				[
					agent.state.status === "",
					agent.state.current_version_id !== version.id,
					[
						version.state.minted,
						version.state.agent_id === agent.id,
						version.state.version === agent.state.version,
						version.state.name === agent.state.name,
						version.state.model_id === agent.state.model_id,
						version.state.has_system === agent.state.has_system,
						version.state.system === agent.state.system,
						version.state.has_description === agent.state.has_description,
						version.state.description === agent.state.description,
					].every((ok) => ok),
				].some((ok) => ok)

Checkfu.VersionNumbersAreDistinct.source:
({ a, b }) =>
				[
					a.id === b.id,
					!a.state.minted,
					!b.state.minted,
					a.state.agent_id !== b.state.agent_id,
					a.state.version !== b.state.version,
				].some((ok) => ok)

Session.GenerationNeverDecreases.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.generation >= before.generation

Session.GenerationAdvancesByAtMostOne.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.generation <= before.generation + 1

Session.GenerationHoldsWithinTurn.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Running" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			after.turn !== before.turn ||
			after.generation === before.generation

Session.IdleSessionStartsTurnUnderItsGen.source:
({ before, after }) =>
			before._tag !== "Idle" ||
			after._tag !== "Running" ||
			(after.turn === before.turn + 1 && after.generation === before.generation)

Session.StatusRunningCarriesStartedTurnA.source:
({ after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_running" ||
					(after._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === after.turn &&
						event.generation === after.generation),
			)

Session.StatusIdleCarriesEndedTurnAndNex.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "session.status_idle" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === before.turn &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" || after._tag === "Running") &&
						event.generation === after.generation),
			)

Session.AbandonedTurnRetiresItsGeneratio.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "turn.abandoned" ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						event.turn === before.turn &&
						event.generation === before.generation &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" || after._tag === "Running") &&
						after.generation === before.generation + 1),
			)

Session.TruncatedReplyRetiresGeneration.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			events.every(
				(event) =>
					event._tag !== "agent.message" ||
					event.truncated !== true ||
					(before._tag === "Running" &&
						(after._tag === "Idle" || after._tag === "Running") &&
						after.generation === before.generation + 1),
			)

Session.OnlyAbandonmentOrTruncationRetir.source:
({ before, after, events }) =>
			(before._tag !== "Idle" && before._tag !== "Running") ||
			(after._tag !== "Idle" && after._tag !== "Running") ||
			after.generation === before.generation ||
			events.some(
				(event) =>
					event._tag === "turn.abandoned" ||
					(event._tag === "agent.message" && event.truncated === true),
			)
